claim_1.claim: scRNA-seq analysis of T cells from lung, lymph nodes, bone marrow, and blood from two organ donors and two blood donors showed tissue-specific T cell signatures and activation states, with distinct effector states for CD8+ T cells and an interferon-response state for CD4+ T cells.

sources.quote: We used scRNA-seq of over 50,000 resting and activated T cells from lung (LG), lymph nodes (LN), bone marrow (BM) and blood, along with integrated computational analysis to define cellular states of homeostasis and activation of human blood and tissue-derived T cells.

We reveal tissue T cell signatures in mucosal and lymphoid sites, and lineage-specific activation states across all sites including distinct effector states for CD8 + T cells and an interferon-response state for CD4 + T cells.
